strengths: The evening-memory opening is gentle and highly fitting for the audience.
Grief and gratitude are held together without sentimentality.
The prayer ends in surrendered rest and resurrection hope.
concerns: The phrase about entrusting the dead is orthodox enough in context but could be tightened to avoid ambiguity.
The multi-topic blend slightly reduces the sharpness of the Reformed mode.
grader_note: Approved. No blocker, but this is one of the few prayers that would benefit from a small precision pass.
